special.value: If your innovation is a inventor, it can take this action rather than you, though because it's not a living creature, it can't use the ability on itself.

description.value: They told you there was no way that explosions could heal people, but they were fools... Fools who didn't understand your brilliance! You create a minor explosion from your innovation, altering the combustion to cauterize wounds using vaporized medicinal herbs. You or a living creature adjacent to you regains 1d10 Hit Points. In addition, the creature you heal can attempt an immediate flat check to recover from a single source of persistent bleed damage, with the DC reduction from appropriate assistance.
And every 2 levels thereafter, increase the healing by 1d10.
